scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/myproject/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/myproject
  set jcr:title{String} to "My Project"
end
create service user myproject-cf-exporter with path system/cq:services/myproject

set ACL for myproject-cf-exporter
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
end
